scenarios.mech: Finalize recommendations for consistent IFU content and format, emphasizing clear patient instructions across covered prescription products.
Retain patient comprehension objectives while allowing greater flexibility in recommended IFU organization and presentation.
Strengthen selected clarity recommendations while relaxing others to accommodate differences among covered products.

forecasts.notes: The draft establishes a concrete guidance project, but nearly three years of elapsed time provides little timing precision. Guidance finalization often takes years; the standardized patient-information objective favors continuity conditional on adoption.

scenarios.mech: Authorize government securities lending and borrowing to complement special repos and enable deployment of idle securities.
Preserve the lending framework while easing operational requirements or allowing a longer implementation period.
Combine participation flexibility with stronger operational safeguards while retaining government securities lending and borrowing.

forecasts.notes: An explicit policy commitment followed promptly by draft directions supports eventual adoption. Comments closed over eight months ago, allowing substantial processing time, but publication timing and unresolved operational issues remain uncertain.

Retain transparency objectives while narrowing obligations or providing more implementation flexibility for lending service providers.

forecasts.notes: Acceptance of the working-group recommendation, a policy announcement and a draft demonstrate sustained commitment. Four months since comments closed permits finalization, although multi-lender implementation questions can prolong consultation or produce revisions.

scenarios.mech: Finalize industry guidance retaining its principal recommendations after stakeholder discussion.
Finalize guidance with a combination of more flexible and more demanding recommendations reflecting stakeholder discussions.

forecasts.notes: The excerpt identifies draft industry guidance and continued discussion but reveals no substantive recommendations. Guidance commonly remains pending beyond a year. Timing and conditional content estimates therefore rely predominantly on broad process base rates.
